@graph.name: Custom Zebra Blind
@graph.description: Custom-made zebra blind with alternating opaque and sheer fabric bands for light and privacy control.

acceptedAnswer.text: A zebra blind is a modern window covering made with alternating opaque and sheer fabric bands. By aligning or overlapping the bands, users can adjust light transmission and privacy.
A roller blind, also known as a roller shade, is a window covering in which a fabric panel rolls around a tube. It can be used for light control, privacy or room darkening depending on the fabric.
